notes.text:
This update for libsoup fixes the following issue

- CVE-2026-4271: use-after-free in the HTTP/2 server when user signal handlers disconnect connections during callback
  execution (bsc#1259767).

notes.text: A flaw was found in libsoup, a library for handling HTTP requests. This vulnerability, known as a Use-After-Free, occurs in the HTTP/2 server implementation. A remote attacker can exploit this by sending specially crafted HTTP/2 requests that cause authentication failures. This can lead to the application attempting to access memory that has already been freed, potentially causing application instability or crashes, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).
